# Station routes panel captures — PR #4244

Retention: source-pinned visual evidence for this PR; retain with its review history.
Captured from `52259c2ba7795338b924dd9a3d02e63541c91119` in headless Chromium on an isolated instance
(`./station start --watch --temp-home`) with the Station routes preview on and
a Tailscale route added by hand. These show UI state only, not native shell rendering.

- `routes-view-dark-390.jpg`, `routes-view-light-1440.jpg`: the Routes list, the
  local route in use.
- `routes-edit-light-390.jpg`, `routes-edit-dark-1440.jpg`: after **Edit**, remove
  buttons on routes the user added.
- `routes-add-dark-1440.jpg`, `routes-add-light-390.jpg`: after **+ Add route**.
